behavior: A granted checkout can recompose after branch observation changes when the exact registered checkout remains verified and the current session retains valid claims for that same checkout.
Duplicate same-session claim records for one verified checkout are treated as one logical owner; the immutable claim records remain in Store.
Claims from another session, malformed claim records, mismatched checkout identity, and unrelated worktree scopes remain fail-closed.
Legacy repository-wide claims remain usable only when the exact owner-granted checkout identity still matches; they do not authorize branch-drift fallback.

limitations: The full Environment suite was not rerun for this slice; all 52 scope-grant tests and five focused Environment continuation/toolchain tests passed.
